notes: AP, SOS and overall record MUST be joined from existing authoritative production sources, not assigned invented values. Null fields in staging must not overwrite live AP/SOS fields.
FBS archive record excludes FCS opponents and is not a substitute for overall team record.
Average opposing offensive/defensive quality uses opponent ratings frozen at the end of the previous week, excludes Week 1 and other unavailable opponents; per-game equal weighting.
Offense/Defense combination uses arithmetic mean of the two unit rating metrics; rank ordered descending.
Overall Team Strength is the independently approved 25/35/25/15 rating and is preserved.
